description: This file defines the InlineCOBLoanItemWriter class, which extends AbstractLoanItemWriter and provides specific locking behavior for inline COB (Close Of Business) loan processing within the Fineract project.

classes.name: InlineCOBLoanItemWriter
classes.description: A specialized writer class for inline COB loan processing that manages locking via a specific LockOwner.

methods.name: InlineCOBLoanItemWriter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the writer with a LoanLockingService.

methods.name: getLockOwner
methods.description: Returns the specific LockOwner for inline COB processing, which is used to acquire the appropriate lock during loan item processing.
